This '''mission''' took place in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] established a base on a [[Unidentified Ando system planetoid|planetoid]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]], which they used as a temporary stopover point. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] learned of it and decided to send [[Strike Force Cularin]], a force made up of Republic, [[Cularin Militia]] and [[Thaereian military]] units, to destroy it. The strikeforce assembled in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] an then traveled to the Ando system.

==The mission==
The task force arrived in the Ando system and they attacked and captured a Separatist [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] boarded it and found that most of the crew were dead. Among the survivors was the ship's second officer, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Rame Cartroll]], who they captured. However, they were attacked by [[Solenoid]], [[Sheel]], four other [[Wyrd]] members and [[Gura Tran]]. Tran was a representative of the Thaereian military who was secretly meeting with the CIS. Rast'tul was worried that the heroes might discover this, so he had a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] attack the corvette. It was destroyed and Rast'tul claimed that the pilot was acting alone. A number of starfighters were recovered from the corvette and fitted with Republic [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder codes]].

The Republic soon after landed their [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] onto the planetoid and began to attack the Separatists. They fought against CIS [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and organic troopers. During the fighting, Rast'tul was attacked, but was saved by the Heroes of Cularin. He was enraged that it was they who had saved him and in his anger, he accidentally admitted sending the Headhunter to kill. [[Lazlo Ardine]] overhead and had some clones arrest him. The clones pushed on with the attack, until the base was captured.

==Aftermath==
Strike Force Cularin withdrew and returned to the Cularin system, where it was disbanded. A [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that they heroes had recovered from the Separatist corvette was later decrypted and it proved the treachery of the Thaereians, as it showed that they had allied themselves with the CIS.
